item.title: Item arrives late to beat Constitution River in York’s International Stakes – horse racing live
item.summary: Updates from the opening day’s card at York Constitution River can fill Bow Echo void | Mail Greg It all went according to plan for the low-numbered stalls there, as Lexington Blitz fired out into the lead and gave the far side an advantage that they never surrendered. The first four home were drawn five, nine, four and six. Continue reading...
